newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 19.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The "People's Daily" issues an editorial, warning listed companies against publishing false financial statements and illegally trading their own shares, saying Beijng is determined to crack down on irregularities.
- Deputy governor of the People's Bank, the central bank, says China's economy is large enough to support both Shanghai and Hong Kong as major financial centres.
- Haitong Securities Co takes measures to standardise its operations after Beijing punished the brokerage for illegal credit trading on the stock markets.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai has expanded the Waigaoqiao Free Trade Development Zone in Pudong, China's largest duty-free zone in China, to 6.4 square km from 5.5 square km.
- Commentary says Hong Kong's return to China may boost Shanghai's sluggish property market.
